task_summary: Conducted comprehensive interface quality, accessibility (WCAG), and AI slop anti-patterns audit of the BukSU CMS-V2 Capstone Analytics & Reports Command Center (/reports) using the i-audit and i-frontend-design skills. Captured 11 high-resolution visual evidence artifacts across desktop (1440x900) light/dark modes, mobile (390x844), interactive query drawer, and emulated @media print layout. Uncovered 13 prioritized findings (2 Critical, 3 High, 5 Medium, 3 Low), including Recharts SVG Donut chart label boundary clipping ('Review' sliced off leaving '[20-25%) (33%)'), rotated X-axis tick & bottom legend collisions, detailed records table administrative drill-down dead-ends, ADM yield rate hero metric line-wrapping with 'Multi-Tier ADM Complia...' subtext truncation, synthetic mock data fabrication fallbacks on empty server responses, and mobile touch target sizing violations (< 44px). Compiled actionable roadmap and suggested command matrix (/i-arrange, /i-polish, /i-typeset, /i-harden, /i-distill, /i-normalize, /i-clarify).
